about: Original artwork for Последняя Орбита. PNG originals from OpenAI image generation through Codex CLI; WebP conversions preserve content and alpha. No project provider was called.

assets.title: Последняя Орбита
assets.prompt:
Generate one image and save it as cover.png in the current directory.
Wide landscape key art, 3:2. A riveted orbital prison transfer station shaped like a slow-turning ring hangs above a colossal cloud-banded planet that fills half the sky. In the foreground, behind a frosted panoramic window, a line of eight prisoners in orange robes with blank number patches stands at roll call (two fighters, two rogues, two healers, two light-projection specialists), one of them turning to look out. Outside the glass a tiny tethered figure in a pressure suit crawls along the outer hull towards a small docked shuttle, a red warning light pulsing at an airlock. Cold glass, rivets, vacuum silence, defiance and hope.

Match one consistent house style: original premium illustrated science fiction for older teens and adults, painterly gouache and oil with clean confident ink lines, crisp readable silhouettes, cold glass and brushed steel lit by the reflected glow of a huge cloud-banded planet; palette of deep space navy and graphite, frosted glass cyan, warm prison-robe orange, pale planet-light gold and a single signal red; rows of rivets, frost on viewports, quiet weightless tension and hope. Prison robes carry blank stencilled number patches with no legible digits. No gore, no wounds, no weapons pointed at the viewer, no franchise references, no anime look, no photorealism. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border.
